maptitle.text: ISC Brewers Guild — member onboarding wizard & portal

q1.text:
DECIDED — Draft layer
Wizard and portal edits save to a draft. Preview shows the draft; Publish pushes it live. Applies to already-published (imported) members too.

q2.text:
DECIDED — Member type
Member confirms the Guild's type, or picks the right one (Guild admin gets an email when they do). Locked after that. Later changes = support request to the Guild admin.

q3.text:
DECIDED — Getting in & when the wizard shows
'Member Portal' link sits under 'Member Sign In' in the footer, same magic link. Old path = fallback while testing.

Wizard runs until the member confirms type AND clicks Continue on The Basics. After that: portal only, forever, for everyone on that member.

q4.text:
DECIDED — Second editor
Once the owner has finished setup, a newly added editor goes straight to the portal. The wizard runs once per member, not once per person.

q5.text:
DECIDED — One set of editors
Each wizard step IS a portal section in guided order: same form component, same fields, same save. Wizard = step chrome (Back / Skip / Continue) wrapped around it. Nothing built twice.

q6.text:
DECIDED — Photos & events editor
Owner invites/removes from People. This role sees only Photos & video and Events, can't connect a calendar, and publishes (or discards) only Photos & video — the owner's other draft changes stay put.
